description: This file contains testing utilities for sharding and timing of tests in the PyTorch project, including functions for test duration estimation, sharding logic, and environment setup.

classes.name: ShardJob
classes.description: Manages serial and parallel test shards and computes total execution time.

methods.name: get_with_pytest_shard
methods.description: Creates test shards based on estimated durations, splitting long tests into multiple shards.

methods.name: get_duration
methods.description: Calculates the estimated duration of a test based on file and class timing data.

methods.name: shard
methods.description: Distributes tests into shards, balancing serial and parallel execution based on estimated times.

methods.name: calculate_shards
methods.description: Main function to compute test shards given total number of shards and timing data.

methods.name: get_test_case_configs
methods.description: Retrieves disabled test configurations for a given directory.
